title: ade settings
description: ~/.ade/settings.json — machine-wide, read fresh on every use.

scan_dirs.description: Directories searched for git checkouts, shallowly: a directory holding your repositories, not your whole home.

ignored_dirs.description: Left out of the scan. A path drops that directory and anything under it; a bare name drops every directory called that.

instructions.description: Told to every agent ade starts, in every repository. Appended to the system prompt.

default_role.description: The machine-wide prompt used for new main chats.

role_models.description: The model each role runs on, by role name.

linear_api_key.description: A read-only personal API key, for the issues assigned to you. Stored in plain text.

wiki_remote.description: The shared wiki's git origin. Empty leaves wiki support off.

wiki_distill.description: Publish pages distilled from this machine's transcripts. Off by default: the text goes to a git remote.

wiki_verbatim.description: Let a repository publish full prompts in its commit records.

sharpen_off.description: Do not ask about a vague prompt before it is sent.

merge_queued_off.description: Do not send prompts queued during one run to the agent as one turn.

github_packages_token.description: Authenticates private npm packages in sandboxes. Used as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN. Stored in plain text.

home_assistant.description: Flash a light at the desk, notify a phone anywhere.

token.description: A long-lived access token. Stored in plain text.

dashboard.description: Push this machine's usage to a kiosk screen. Off unless both url and token are set.

token.description: A bearer token. Stored in plain text.

host.description: What this machine reports as. Defaults to its hostname.

claude_account.description: Which subscription this machine's Claude login belongs to. The same label on two machines means one account; empty reports nothing for Claude.

sandbox.description: What every container gets, whatever the repository. A repository's own sandbox.json is laid over this.

ignore.description: Standing rules for what never reaches the dashboard.

agentbus.description: The team bus: questions from other people's agents, and review requests.

off.description: Do not join agentbus at all.

url.description: The bus to join. Empty finds it through tailscale.

repos.description: Globs on owner/repo. Only these repositories' reviews are offered here; empty takes them all.

hosts.description: Other machines to run ade on, over ssh. A bookmark list: the name is handed to ssh.

deep_background.description: Take a palette's deeper background where it has one.
